tool.name: FX Replay
tool.description: FX Replay is a browser tool for replaying past market prices and placing simulated trades. Forex is included, and higher plans add other markets and finer data. FX Replay says it is not a broker and does not send trade signals.
features: Replay past prices in the browser and place simulated trades, candle by candle
A journal stores those session trades. How many screenshots you can keep depends on the plan
Indicators are included, with a higher limit on the paid plans
Intermediate and Pro add a prop firm simulator. Pro adds seconds data and futures data

plans.name: Beginner
plans.detail: The free plan on the pricing page. It includes 2 backtesting sessions, 1 indicator and 1 week of data retention. The page says no card is required.

plans.name: Intermediate, annual
plans.detail: Yearly billing at $180 per year. The same page says monthly billing is $17.99. Includes 10 sessions, 200 trades per session, 6 months of data retention, 3 indicators and 2 charts.

plans.name: Pro, annual
plans.detail: Yearly billing at $350 per year. The pricing card shows $29.16 per month. The FAQ on the same page says $29.17 per month. Monthly billing is $35. Adds unlimited sessions and indicators, seconds data, and futures data.

tool.pricing_note: USD prices from the official pricing page on 3 Nov 2026, with yearly billing selected. Taxes may apply. The FAQ on that page rounds the Pro yearly rate to $29.17 per month.

_notes.source: Pricing page https://fxreplay.com/pricing . What the product is, and that it is not a broker or a signal service: https://support.fxreplay.com/articles/what-is-fx-replay .
